title: Cabin Familiarization: Configure the Crew Cabin

steps.hint: Look to your right at chest height for the panel labelled CABIN CONTROL. It holds the switches for the cabin systems.
The CABIN LIGHTS toggle is top-left on the CABIN CONTROL panel. Check its label shows ON and the cabin brightens.
The AIR FAN dial is right of CABIN LIGHTS. Check it points at LOW; low keeps air moving while cabin noise stays down.
Select the CHECKLIST tab on the CABIN SETUP display above the panels. A checklist lists every step so none is missed.
The COMMS panel is to the left of CABIN CONTROL. Comms means communications with mission control.
COMMS CHECK is the top button on the COMMS panel. It sends a test call; check the green READY light turns on.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT to confirm the cabin is configured.
steps.hint: REPORT is below COMMS CHECK on the COMMS panel. Check the green READY light is on; REPORT tells mission control setup is complete.
